scripts.build:core: npm run build -w @yuanfang/shared && npm run build -w @yuanfang/core
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @yuanfang/desktop
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w @yuanfang/desktop
scripts.start: npm run build:core && npm run start -w @yuanfang/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck -w @yuanfang/shared && npm run typecheck -w @yuanfang/core && npm run typecheck -w @yuanfang/desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @yuanfang/desktop
